cn: {spacing:8181}{actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}「在此献上栖息于此地之魔物{line}{blank}所持有的{color:8091}{arg:8090}{color:BB808080}吧。{line}{blank}化为开启坚固门扉的一部分。」

us: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}{center:8180}Benighted child,{line}Unchosen, with life so short,{line}This tower freely may you tread.{page}{center:8180}In your passing, learn of truth.{line}In your passing, speak of truth.{line}These words writ by Hands Undying.
de: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}{center:8180}{fixed-advance:8194}Sterblicher, dieser Turm entscheidet{line}weder für noch gegen dich.{page}{center:8180}Erfahre die Wahrheit am eigenen Leibe.{line}Verkünde die Wahrheit mit deinem Munde.{fixed-advance:8180}
es: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}{center:8180}Criatura ignorante de vida fugaz{line}que elegida no has sido, esta torre{line}el paso no te impide.{page}{center:8180}Que tu cuerpo la verdad aprenda;{line}que tu boca solo la verdad diga;{line}son palabras por los inmortales inscritas.
fr: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}{center:8180}Enfant ignorant, ni élu ni éternel,{line}erre à ta guise en cette tour du ciel.{page}{center:8180}Que ta chair souffre la vérité,{line}afin que tes mots soient vérité.{line}Ainsi les Immortels ont parlé.
it: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}{center:8180}"Stolta creatura, esclusa ed effimera!{line} La torre non ti rigetta."{page}{center:8180}"Con gli atti apprendi la verità{line} e con la parola trasmettila.{line} Queste le parole degli Immortali."

us: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}"Ahead the watcher waits, second of three.{line}Ye without strength, return whence you came."
de: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}{fixed-advance:8194}Öffne das Portal. Betrete die Blutbühne{line}des Grauens, die vom 2. Faktotum behaust{line}ist. Kraftloser, ein Zurück gibt es nicht.{fixed-advance:8180}
es: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}"Avanza, y al segundo guardián encontrarás.{line}  Pero si de fuerza careces, aquí nunca{line}  volver podrás".
fr: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}« Derrière, veille le deuxième des trois gardiens.{line}Toi qui de force n'as guère, repars d'où tu viens. »
it: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}"Il secondo guardiano attende innanzi.{line} Rinuncia se di forza manchi!"
in: {spacing:8181}{actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}「これより先{line}{blank}第二のしもべ構えたる場。{line}{blank}力なき者、戻り来ることかなわず。」
kr: {spacing:8181}{actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}「이 앞은{line} 두 번째 종복이 기다리는 장소.{line} 힘 없는 자, 돌아오지 못하리.」
cn: {spacing:8181}{actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}「前方为第二仆人{line}{blank}等候之处。{line}{blank}无力者，无能返回。」
ch: {spacing:8181}{actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}「前方為第二僕人{line}{blank}等候之處。{line}{blank}無力者，無能返回。」

us: {speed:8180}The dais returns to its original floor under{line}power of some mysterious force.
de: {speed:8180}Auf die Ausgangsebene zurückgelangt.{line}Eine mysteriöse Macht scheint zu wirken.
es: {speed:8180}El elevador ha vuelto al nivel de partida;{line}parece que lo mueve una fuerza misteriosa.
fr: {speed:8180}Une force mystérieuse ramène{line}la dalle à son étage d'origine.
it: {speed:8180}Una forza misteriosa ha riportato{line}l'ascensore al piano originario.
in: {spacing:8181}{speed:8180}元の層に戻された。{line}謎の力が作用しているようだ。
kr: {spacing:8181}{speed:8180}원래 있던 층으로 돌려보내졌다.{line}정체불명의 힘이 작용하는 듯하다.
cn: {spacing:8181}{speed:8180}被丢回原本的楼层了。{line}似乎有神秘力量在作用。
ch: {spacing:8181}{speed:8180}被丟回原本的樓層了。{line}似乎有神祕力量在作用。

us: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}Nothing happens. This chamber appears to be{line}affecting the dais.
de: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}Keine Reaktion. Die erdrückende Aura des{line}Unheilvollen in diesen Arkaden könnte die{line}Ursache sein ...
es: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}No ocurre nada; parece que es debido{line}a la energía dañina de este lugar.
fr: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}Rien ne se passe. Quelque chose dans ce hall{line}semble affecter la dalle.
in: {spacing:8181}{actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}反応がない。この空間の異常が影響しているようだ。
kr: {spacing:8181}{actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}반응이 없다.이 공간의 이상이 영향을 미치는 듯하다.
cn: {spacing:8181}{actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}毫无反应。似乎受到这个空间的异常影响。
ch: {spacing:8181}{actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}毫無反應。似乎受到這個空間的異常影響。

us: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}This wall appears different from the others.{line}{choice:2}[Strike the wall.|Do nothing.]
de: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}Etwas scheint an dieser Wand merkwürdig ...{line}{choice:2}[Angreifen|Nichts machen]
es: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}Esta pared parece distinta de las otras.{line}{choice:2}[Golpearla.|No hacer nada.]
fr: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}Ce mur paraît différent des autres.{line}{choice:2}[Le frapper.|Ne rien faire.]
it: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}Questo muro sembra diverso dagli altri.{line}{choice:2}[Lo colpisco.|Non faccio niente.]
in: {spacing:8181}{actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}他とは異なる印象を受ける壁がある。{line}{choice:2}[衝撃を与える|何もしない]
kr: {spacing:8181}{actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}다른 것과는 인상이 다른 벽이 있다.{line}{choice:2}[충격을 가한다|아무것도 안 한다]
cn: {spacing:8181}{actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}有面给人不同印象的墙壁。{line}{choice:2}[给予冲击|什么都不做]
ch: {spacing:8181}{actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}有面給人不同印象的牆壁。{line}{choice:2}[給予衝擊|什麼都不做]

in: {spacing:8181}{actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}古代の文字が刻み込まれている。{line}{choice:2}[碑文を読む|何もしない]
kr: {spacing:8181}{actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}고대의 문자가 새겨져 있다.{line}{choice:2}[비문을 읽는다|아무것도 안 한다]
cn: {spacing:8181}{actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}上面刻着古代文字。{line}{choice:2}[阅读碑文|什么都不做]

us: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}"{color:8091}Black orbs{color:BB808080} the darkness of this hall dispel.{line}In proper measure, light once more they bring.{line}In overabundance, for naught are they spent."
de: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}{fixed-advance:8194}Opfere die {color:8091}Schattenperlen{color:BB808080}, um das Dunkel{line}zu vertreiben. Stimmt ihre Zahl, erscheine{line}dir Licht, eine jede Perle sonst verblicht.{fixed-advance:8180}
es: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}"Las {color:8091}Esferas oscuras{color:BB808080} ahuyentan a las sombras.{line}  Ofrenda cierta cantidad y la luz regresará.{line}  Ofrenda más de la cuenta y se perderán en vano".
fr: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}« Les {color:8091}orbes noirs{color:BB808080} savent les ténèbres dissiper.{line}Avec mesure, la lumière ils peuvent ramener.{line}Avec excès, pour rien ils sont gaspillés. »
it: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}"Per disperdere le tenebre usa le {color:8091}Perle nere{color:BB808080}.{line} La luce tornerà se inserisci la giusta quantità.{line} Ma se eccedi, tutto sarà stato fatto invano."
in: {spacing:8181}{actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}「この闇を払いたくば{color:8091}{arg:8090}{color:BB808080}をおさめよ。{line}{blank}おさめし数に導かれ、やがて光おとずれん。{line}{blank}おさめし数が過ぎし時、珠吸い込まれ虚無とならん。」
kr: {spacing:8181}{actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}「이 어둠을 쫓고 싶으면 {color:8091}{arg:8090}{color:BB808080}을 넣어라.{line} 넣은 개수에 이끌려, 빛이 찾아오리라.{line} 너무 많은 구슬을 넣으면, 구슬이 빨려 들어가 사라지리라.」
cn: {spacing:8181}{actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}「想拔除这股黑暗就放入{color:8091}{arg:8090}{color:BB808080}吧。{line}{blank}随着放入的数量指引，光明终将到来。{line}{blank}当放入过量时，珠子将被吸入，化为虚无。」
ch: {spacing:8181}{actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}「想袚除這股黑暗就放入{color:8091}{arg:8090}{color:BB808080}吧。{line}{blank}隨著放入的數量指引，光明終將到來。{line}{blank}當放入過量時，珠子將被吸入，化為虛無。」
